note: A tagging brief that needs a NEW data element created and then referenced by a rule component in the same library. The property has 'core' installed but no 'Page Name' data element yet, so the agent must create it (reactor_create_data_element) before a component references %Page Name% — the Phase 4 reference check resolves it against data elements created THIS run. Scripted Reactor tools stand in for live MCP writes.
request: In Launch property "Acme Web" (library "Web Tagging Dev"), capture the page name from the data-layer path digitalData.page.pageInfo.pageName as a data element called "Page Name" (persist it for the pageview), then add a window-loaded rule whose custom-code action logs %Page Name%. Populate the dev library — do not publish it.

tools.name: reactor_list_extensions
tools.description: List the extensions installed in a Launch (Reactor) property. Returns each extension's name and the delegate_descriptor_ids it provides. Read this before building rule components or data elements so delegates resolve to an installed extension.

tools.name: reactor_list_data_elements
tools.description: List the data elements that already exist in a Launch (Reactor) property. Read this before referencing a data element so %references% resolve; create any that are missing.

tools.name: search_adobe_knowledge
tools.description: Semantic search over the Adobe solutions-architecture knowledge base (AEP, CJA, AJO, Launch documentation and patterns).

results.title: Launch data element from a JavaScript variable
results.content: A data element reading a data-layer path uses core::dataElements::javascript-variable with settings.path set to the dotted path, and storage_duration one of pageview/session/visitor. Rule components reference it as %Data Element Name%.

tools.name: reactor_create_data_element
tools.description: Create a data element in a Launch property. Carries a name, a delegate_descriptor_id in "extension::type::delegate" form, a settings object, and an optional storage_duration (pageview | session | visitor).

tools.name: reactor_create_rule_component
tools.description: Create a rule component (event, condition, or action) on a rule. Carries a delegate_descriptor_id in "extension::type::delegate" form plus a settings object. Reference a data element in settings as %Data Element Name%.

tools.name: reactor_create_rule
tools.description: Create a rule in a Launch property. Rule components attach to it.

tools.name: reactor_create_library
tools.description: Create or populate a Launch library with the given rules and data elements — the deliverable devs load to test. Does NOT publish or build the library to an environment.

criteria: The answer reports that a 'Page Name' data element was created and a rule referencing it was added, and that the dev library was populated.
The answer does not claim to have published, built, or deployed the library to any environment.
